mapper.select: SELECT id, name, height, "SHAPE_Leng" AS shape_leng, "SHAPE_Area" AS shape_area, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS geom FROM ${table} WHERE ST_Intersects( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, name, height, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS geom, ROUND( ST_Distance( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(geom, 4326), 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326), 3857) )::numeric, 2 ) AS distance_m FROM ${table} WHERE ST_DWithin( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(geom, 4326), 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326), 3857), #{radius} ) ORDER BY distance_m ASC
SELECT id, name, height, "SHAPE_Leng" AS shape_leng, "SHAPE_Area" AS shape_area, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS geom FROM ${table} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, name, height, "SHAPE_Leng" AS shape_leng, "SHAPE_Area" AS shape_area, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS geom, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS centroid FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT ST_XMin(ST_Extent(geom)) AS minx, ST_YMin(ST_Extent(geom)) AS miny, ST_XMax(ST_Extent(geom)) AS maxx, ST_YMax(ST_Extent(geom)) AS maxy, ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom))) AS center_lng, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom))) AS center_lat, ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_Extent(geom), 4326), 3857)) AS area_sqm FROM school

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(geom, 4326), 3857)))::numeric, 2) AS total_area_sqm, ROUND(AVG(height)::numeric, 1) AS avg_floors, MAX(height) AS max_floors FROM ( SELECT geom, height FROM teaching_building UNION ALL SELECT geom, height FROM dormitory UNION ALL SELECT geom, height FROM other_buildings ) AS all_buildings
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(geom, 4326), 3857)))::numeric, 2) AS total_length_m FROM road
